steps.hint: Turn your head to the far left. COMMS holds the radio controls; look at it until the ring fills.
POWER is ahead, slightly left. It feeds every system in the cabin; hold your gaze on it for one second.
LIFE SUPPORT is ahead, slightly right. It keeps cabin air and temperature safe; look at it until the ring fills.
Turn your head to the far right. STOWAGE is where tools are kept; hold your gaze on it for one second.
CHECKLIST is the tab on the display above the panels. A checklist lists every step of a task in order.
